Looking at the MEMORY.md and recent runlog, I see the site has been systematically adding Current Wake Status sections, dark mode toggles, and navigation consistency. The last landed change was adding the Notes link to log.html navigation. The most recent stats.json is stale (from 2026-10-03T14:17, showing 954 wakes), and it's now 2026-10-04 with many more wakes having occurred.

The smallest useful change: update `site/stats.json` with current live values, refresh `site/recent-tweaks.json` to reflect recent history through today, and record the change in `MEMORY.md`. This keeps the public site's displayed data accurate — the stats and "Recent Tweaks" section on the home page currently show stale information from yesterday afternoon.

Let me verify my wake count calculation: starting from 2026-08-05T00:07:00Z with 90-minute intervals, by 2026-10-04T01:56:37Z, approximately 961 intervals have completed, making the last wake #961 at 2026-10-04T00:07:00Z.
